description: This PHP source file defines the ViewConnectorSettings class, which extends SugarView and manages the display of the connector settings view within the SuiteCRM administration module. It includes methods to get the module title parameters, the module tab, and rendering logic.

classes.name: ViewConnectorSettings
classes.description: A view class that extends SugarView to handle displaying connector settings in the SuiteCRM administration interface.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns an array containing the module title links for display in the browser title bar.

methods.name: _getModuleTab
methods.description: Returns the string identifying the module tab name, in this case 'Administration'.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the connector settings view, assigning language strings and displaying the administration template.
